name: blue-ai-bridge
description: BlueAIBridge: Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex review and talk to each other, with a live monitoring dashboard and a macOS menu-bar app.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui
scripts.build:linux: docker build -t blueaibridge-linux desktop/packaging/linux && mkdir -p desktop/build/dist && docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/in:ro" -v "$PWD/desktop/build/dist:/out" blueaibridge-linux bash -c 'mkdir /work && tar -C /in --exclude=./.git --exclude=./node_modules --exclude=./dist --exclude=./desktop/build --exclude=./desktop/.dart_tool -cf - . | tar -C /work -xf - && cd /work/desktop && bash packaging/linux/build.sh /out'
